title: R1 — FTC companion chatbot inquiry, September 2025
note: Information-gathering inquiry, not a finding that every recipient committed abuse.

title: R2 — AMA informed-consent ethics
note: Medical ethics analogy; not presented as a chatbot statute.

title: R3 — Canadian privacy commissioners: OpenAI joint investigation, May 2026
note: Examined GPT-3.5/GPT-4 practices; federal conditional resolution and unresolved provincial findings must remain distinct.

title: R4 — FTC Facebook privacy settlement, July 2019
note: Historical settlement; not a claim about current case outcomes.

title: R5 — FTC 2023 privacy and data security update
note: Reports the May 2023 allegations and proposed order changes, including Messenger Kids; not a final finding of every allegation.

title: R6 — How the FTC provides refunds
note: Supports direct distributions using company records; does not establish full compensation in every case.

title: R7 — CFPB Civil Penalty Fund
note: Existing pooled fund; actual payments depend on available funds and eligibility rules. Not the normative AI compensation framework.

title: R8 — AAFP decision-making capacity overview
note: Clinical framework; diagnosis alone is not incapacity. Not a general licensing test for AI.
